title: AGY PPT project state
description: Deterministic, AGY-owned project state for the agy-ppt workflow. AGY is the only controller; workers (Kiro, Codex) never write this file directly.

controller.description: State ownership is AGY only. This value must never change.

phase_before_block.description: When phase is 'blocked', the phase the project was in before it was blocked, so AGY can decide where to resume.

sequential_only.description: First version renders slides sequentially. Parallel generation is intentionally out of scope.

operator_blocker.description: Orchestration/operator-confirmed block (e.g. subscription quota exhaustion confirmed via an external UI). Distinct from a worker-reported error_code: this field never overrides or is derived from a slide's attempts/blocker, and a slide's blocker.error_code is never rewritten to a value from here.

reason.description: e.g. 'subscription_quota_exhausted'. Always an operator/AGY decision, never a fabricated worker error_code.

generation.description: Number of real Codex generation calls made for this slide. 0 before the first call.

generating_attempt.description: The generation number of the in-flight attempt while status is 'generating'.

reason.description: e.g. 'codex generation failed' (from record_worker_result), 'interrupted during generation; outcome unconfirmed' (from recover_interrupted), or 'repeated_image_backend_failure' (from block_after_repeated_failure, after a second consecutive same-error_code failure on this slide).

error_code.description: The worker-reported error_code this blocker preserves verbatim (e.g. 'IMAGE_GENERATION_FAILED'). Never a quota-specific code inferred from a returncode; never rewritten by an operator-confirmed quota decision (see top-level operator_blocker).

retry_immediately.description: Present (false) only on a 'repeated_image_backend_failure' blocker: AGY has determined a second consecutive same-error_code failure must not be retried immediately a third time.
